helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.bett: Allows smooth stepping up blocks <=1.25 blocks high without losing horizontal speed. Inspired by Accessible Step.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.glob: All items with Mending in equipment slots, main/off-hand, hotbar and inventory are repaired when absorbing XP, without needing to be held. Items inside shulker boxes and other containers are ignored.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.bett: When dying, any item with death protection (Totem of Undying) in equipment slots, main/off-hand, hotbar and inventory is triggered, without needing to be held. Items inside shulker boxes and other containers are ignored. Damage sources that bypass invulnerability (e.g. /kill) are not protected, matching vanilla behavior.

When climbing climbable blocks, vertical speed linearly increases based on look pitch. Looking down 20-90 degrees: speed to -0.4, after 60 ticks to -0.6. Looking up 20-90 degrees: speed to 0.25, after 60 ticks to 0.5.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.boat: The maximum height of obstacles a boat can step up over. Range 0-200, default 0.
helpful_tweake.config.hotkeys.comment.op: Opens the Helpful Tweake config GUI
